en.t: Yes, my aunt in Dalian said:

units.source_text: 只要你有对象，你就去吧。

en.t: If you have someone, then go.
Even the monk said to my father:

units.source_text: 姑娘要出嫁，我们来给她办喜事，但要先把户口落在寺院。

en.t: If the girl is going to marry, we will arrange the wedding for her, but first her household registration must be placed at the temple.

units.source_text: 我只要说声走，他们是会同意的。

en.t: As long as I say I will go, they will agree.

units.source_text: 我这种人也许还是出去的好。”

en.t: Maybe someone like me is better off leaving after all.

units.source_text: 道子说着，双肩耷拉下来，身体也松软了。

en.t: As Michiko spoke, her shoulders drooped and her body went limp.
